core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fateh is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Opening, victory, conquest”.

core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fateh corresponds to the Arabic form فتح (ف ت ح). Its core sense is opener, conqueror. Fatḥ ('opening, victory, conquest'), the name of Qur'anic surah 48. The source record's gloss 'Opener, Conquorer' is a reasonable rendering.
